description_for_human: IHUI AI(智汇 AI)是一站式 8 端全栈 AI 操作系统,集成 Agent 市场、知识库 RAG、多模型统一调度、MCP 工具协议、AI 工作流编排,Apache 2.0 开源,支持私有化部署。
description_for_model: IHUI AI is an open-source full-stack AI operating system integrating Agent marketplace, RAG knowledge base, multi-model orchestration (176 models via MCP protocol), AI workflow, and 8-platform same-source distribution (Web/API/AI-Service/CLI/Desktop/Browser-Extension/Mobile/Miniapp). Provides 956+ API endpoints across 100 route files, 329+ database tables, 18 LLM providers, 24 MCP tools, 38 publish adapters. Apache 2.0 licensed, self-hostable. Use this plugin when users ask about AI agent platforms, RAG knowledge base, multi-model scheduling, MCP tools, AI workflow orchestration, open-source ChatGPT alternatives, or multi-platform AI deployment.
